About the Role

The Sr. Warehouse Associate serves as a vital operational anchor and peer leader across daily warehouse, fulfillment, and shipping operations. In this role, you will ensure high-value commercial fitness equipment and components are accurately staged, verified, loaded, and dispatched safely and on schedule. Beyond standard material movement, you will operate as a trusted right-hand partner to warehouse leadership—mentoring and training team members, overseeing daily floor execution, and actively troubleshooting inventory and logistics hurdles.

You will regularly operate sit-down and stand-up/reach forklifts, utilize desktop SAP and RF scanners, and use email to investigate inventory variances, communicate order status directly with internal teams and external customers, and coordinate seamlessly with freight carriers and Customer Service. Success demands proactive ownership, strong communication, meticulous inventory discipline, and an uncompromised commitment to warehouse safety.

Schedule & Compensation

  • Work Schedule: 4x10 Schedule (Monday – Thursday, 6:00 AM – 5:00 PM) + Friday half days (6:00 AM – 12:00 PM). Schedule flexibility and overtime may be mandatory based on shipping volumes. 

  • Pay Rate: $21.00 – $23.00 per hour (based on experience).

 

Responsibilities

  • Order Staging and Shipment Preparation: Pull and stage orders using pick sheets, follow FIFO inventory practices, and prepare finished goods for shipment.
  • Shipping and Receiving: Load and unload trailers, verify shipments, and ensure orders are handled accurately and efficiently. 
  • Team Support and Training: Assist the supervisor with onboarding and training new team members. Support cross-training initiatives to improve flexibility, coverage, and departmental efficiency.
  • Cross-Functional Communication: Serve as a point of contact for routine warehouse and shipping matters, coordinating with Inventory Control, Production, Customer Service, Sales, and transportation providers. Communicate discrepancies, delays, and issues requiring escalation to the supervisor.
  • Inventory Accuracy: Use RF barcode scanners, SAP, and warehouse computer systems to verify orders, track inventory movements, and maintain accurate inventory records.
  • Equipment Operation and Safety: Operate forklifts and/or reach trucks safely and efficiently. Follow all company safety policies and maintain awareness of safe material-handling practices.
  • Warehouse Organization: Maintain a clean, organized warehouse and shipping area. Identify equipment, tool, and supply needs and report issues as appropriate.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve safety, accuracy, workflow, and customer service. Contribute to departmental goals and promote teamwork, accountability, and timely execution.
  • Team Participation: Attend scheduled departmental and staff meetings and perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • 2+ years of experience operating a forklift or reach truck, or equivalent experience in a warehouse or manufacturing environment.
  • Working knowledge of SAP and/or comparable warehouse management systems.
  • Understanding of inventory flow and warehouse material-handling processes.
  • Experience with cycle counting, shipping, and receiving.
  • Ability to use RF scanners and computer-based inventory systems.
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and commitment to safety.
  • Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across warehouse and production teams.
  • Ability to assist with training and cross-training team members.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule and mandatory overtime when business needs require it.

Working Environment

Work is performed indoors in a heated modern factory space.  Ambient working temperature may range from 50 F – 90 F, depending on the season.  The work area is clean and free from wet, slippery conditions. Employees are required to wear personal protective equipment such as safety glasses, safety shoes, hearing protection and gloves.  A respirator may be required if applicable.

 

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions where available.

 

  • Ability to lift to 40 lbs.
  • Ability to frequently (6-8 hrs.): talk and/or hear, see, stand, use hands, reach at or above the shoulder.
  • Ability to routinely (4-6 hrs.): bend, do simple finger grasping, lift waist to shoulder.
  • Ability to occasionally (2-4 hrs.): walk, lift floor to waist, reach above the shoulder, push, and pull using wheeled carts and bins.
  • Ability to on a rare basis (0-2 hrs.): Sit, kneel, or crawl, stoop or squat, twist, use of feet (foot pedals), lifting shoulder to overhead, climb (small ladder) or balance.

 

As an organization, one of our top priorities is to maintain the health and well-being of our employees and their families. To achieve this goal, we offer robust and comprehensive benefits including: 

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Generous paid time off policy
  • Short-term and long-term disability
  • Access to Employee Assistance Program; including access to mental health services
  • 401(k) including employer match
  • Pet insurance and so much more!

Precor is known for developing and manufacturing the most innovative and reliable commercial fitness equipment on the market. With over 40 years of empowering exercisers, trainers, business owners, and operators alike we take pride in offering world-class fitness solutions across over 13,000 facilities and 100+ countries. We sweat every detail to bring best-in-class product solutions into commercial facilities, meeting exercisers wherever they are: at work, at school, in the gym, or on the road.

About the Role

The Supply Planner is part of a team that drives global inventory replenishment plans that meet our customers' needs. The Supply Planner will continually improve our ability to meet customer requirements by balancing the inventory requirements and customer fill rate expectations.  The position involves a high degree of interaction with Manufacturing, Sales, Accounting, Purchasing, Engineering, and other company departments and requires a solid ability to exercise independent judgment.

 

This is a critical role, as errors in the supply plans can decrease Precor's ability to meet customer requirements, and result in missing revenue opportunities.  The Supply Planner will report to the Supply Planning Manager and work with minimal supervision.  The Supply Planner may be asked to engage in or lead the team in special projects.

 

Responsibilities

  • Global Inventory Replenishment Plans: Develop and optimize global inventory replenishment plans for supporting sales of finished goods, raw materials, and customer service parts to align with customer sales order and demand plan requirements.
  • Dynamic Plan Adjustments: Continuously monitor business conditions and make dynamic adjustments to plans to achieve inventory and revenue goals effectively.
  • Data Utilization: Utilize Material Requirements Planning (MRP) and Demand Requirements Planning (DRP) systems to gather global supply data over an 18 to 24-month rolling basis.
  • Safety Stock Management: Evaluate, update, and maintain safety stock levels across all inventory tiers and locations.
  • KPI-Driven Planning: Review supply plans for exceptions and manage abnormal demand while focusing on key performance indicators (KPIs) such as forecast accuracy, working capital, customer fill rate, and inbound freight optimization.
  • Inter-departmental Collaboration: Collaborate with manufacturing engineering and production teams to implement efficient lean replenishment systems, including Kanban and Vendor-Managed Inventory (VMI) planning.
  • Product Lifecycle Inventory Management: Drive end-to-end inventory strategies for product introductions (NPI), engineering changes, and phase-in/phase-out transitions; actively track excess and obsolete (E&O) risk, manage component cannibalization, and ensure seamless run-out across manufacturing and service parts
  • Special projects and a dedication to continuous improvement are also integral parts of the position

 

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is required. 
  • 4+ years of supply planning in a manufacturing environment
  • Fundamental understanding of clear-to-build analysis.
  • Skill in building inventory analysis and time-series modeling in Excel
  • Detail-oriented, results-driven, and proactive, collaborative communication approach.
  • Strong customer service focus and follow-through in meeting internal client needs.
  • Accountability to achieve goals and work independently on assigned tasks
  • Must use a variety of computer programs/systems, at an advanced level, to track results (Excel, Email, Word, PowerPoint, SAP, Agile)

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with an MRP is required; SAP experience
  • Experience with Agile or other BOM management tools

 

Pay Range: $80,000 to $95,000

The pay range represents the low and high end of the anticipated pay range for this position based at our Woodinville, WA headquarters. The actual pay offered for this position will depend on numerous factors including individual performance, business objectives, and if the location for the job changes. Our pay is just one component of Precor’s total rewards strategy that also includes region-specific health and welfare benefits. 

As an organization, one of our top priorities is to maintain the health and well-being of our employees and their families. To achieve this goal, we offer robust and comprehensive benefits including:  

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance 
  • Generous paid time off policy 
  • Short-term and long-term disability 
  • Access to Employee Assistance Program; including access to mental health services 
  • 401(k) including employer match 
  • Pet insurance and so much more!

About the Role

As an Electrical Engineer at Precor, a Peloton Commercial brand, you will design, test, and validate electrical systems for our premium commercial cardio portfolio. Your work will connect physical hardware with the digital user experience, delivering reliable, high-performance fitness equipment for commercial facilities worldwide.

You will contribute throughout the product lifecycle, working closely with internal R&D, cross-functional engineering teams, and global Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and Original Design Manufacturer (ODM) partners. You will apply hands-on expertise in digital display systems, motors and motor controllers, power supplies, and electromagnetics, along with knowledge of embedded software and wireless technologies, to meet product performance, safety, and reliability requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop electrical components and systems in accordance with product requirements and both Precor and Peloton Commercial engineering standards.
  • Translate engineering requirements into practical, cost-effective, reliable designs.
  • Specify, review, and validate electrical designs developed internally and by OEM/ODM partners.
  • Develop and execute test plans to verify electrical performance, safety, reliability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Apply engineering analysis, reliability assessment, and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) to identify and address design risks.
  • Incorporate lean engineering and Design for Manufacturability (DFM) principles to improve product quality, cost, and manufacturing efficiency.
  • Collaborate with R&D to evaluate emerging technologies and develop practical applications that create customer and business value.
  • Build and maintain technical relationships with component manufacturers, contract manufacturers, and OEM/ODM partners.
  • Create and maintain clear technical documentation, including design specifications, analyses, test procedures, and reports.
  • Communicate technical findings, risks, and recommendations clearly to leadership, cross-functional teams, customers, and suppliers.
  • Mentor junior engineers in design, analysis, testing, and problem-solving.
  • Drive continuous improvement in engineering processes, tools, and product performance.

 

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering.
  • 3 years + of product design or engineering experience demonstrating hands-on technical capability.
  • Broad knowledge of electronics design and embedded software, with the ability to specify, review, and validate designs.
  • Proficiency with electrical measurement and diagnostic instruments, including oscilloscopes, network analyzers, and power analyzers.
  • Understanding of design evaluation methods, including reliability analysis, statistical tolerance analysis, and FMEA.
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize work, manage multiple tasks, and meet deadlines.
  • Eagerness to learn new technologies and apply that knowledge to practical engineering challenges.
  • Strong sense of urgency and ownership, with the ability to respond to changing priorities and follow through on commitments.
  • Highly motivated self-starter who takes initiative and works independently while collaborating across teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with a hands-on, analytical approach to troubleshooting and resolving technical issues.
  • Ability to work effectively in a dynamic, cross-functional engineering environment.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering.
  • Experience designing or integrating Android-based display systems.
  • Experience with digital display systems, motors and motor controllers, power supplies, or electromagnetics.
  • Working knowledge of Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and Near Field Communication (NFC) technologies.
  • Familiarity with electromagnetic interference and compatibility (EMI/EMC), including emissions and immunity testing, and applicable FCC and CE requirements.
  • Experience working with contract manufacturers and global OEM/ODM partners.
  • Understanding of project planning, resource allocation, and engineering project management.
  • Familiarity with UL 1647 and IEC 60335 standards.

 

Travel and Physical Requirements

  • Ability to travel up to 10%, domestically and internationally, to support supplier collaboration, meet customers, and observe products in the field.
  • Ability to sit, stand, and walk regularly and occasionally lift up to 40 pounds.

 

Pay Range: $106,000-$120,000
